what: Pre-fetch synthetic positive control 1b on (N_sys=54, k_sys=35, N_inh=15, k_inh=3) initially asserted both Chan-Zhang and Newcombe-Wilson 95% CI lower bounds > 0.15 before evaluating exact unconditional discreteness at N_inh=15.
why: While asymptotic Newcombe-Wilson Method-10 gave lower bound 0.163193 (> 0.15), exact unconditional Chan-Zhang (1999) takes the supremum over all nuisance p2 in [0, 1-delta] on discrete N_inh=15, yielding exact lower bound 0.077872 (> 0.07); calibrated done.md Control 1b to > 0.07 for Chan-Zhang and > 0.15 for Newcombe-Wilson at commit 8bd705f prior to fetching any empirical data.

what: First pre-fetch draft of independent_audit.py used cubic polynomial bisection with eps=1e-22 inside a 20-digit localcontext (ctx.prec=20).
why: At 20 decimal digits, lo + 1e-22 rounded back to lo on delta < 0, triggering a trivial boundary zero on x2=0 rows; replaced cubic expansion in independent_audit.py with exact analytical boundary limits + safeguarded Newton-bisection on the unexpanded binomial log-likelihood derivative at prec=28..50, achieving <= 1e-6 parity with float64 Cardano prior to empirical data fetch.

what: Single-shot empirical evaluation of pre-registered PRED-0017 across locked 71 early-phase non-healthy-volunteer-only PRISMA-940 CFTR trials (54 systemic_cftr vs 15 pure airway-restricted inhaled_cftr_pure and 17 inhaled_cftr_all) on ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 designModule.designInfo.
why: Refuted at the pre-registered alpha = 0.01 Fisher threshold without post-hoc retuning: although systemic CFTR trials carried jointly RANDOMIZED + masked study-level designInfo at a higher rate than pure-inhaled CFTR trials (39/54 = 0.722222 vs 6/15 = 0.400000, risk difference +0.322222, nominal Chan-Zhang 95% CI [0.005320, 0.578285] > 0 and Newcombe-Wilson 95% CI [0.046513, 0.548120] > 0), 6/15 pure-inhaled trials (NCT01621867 pGM169/GL67A, NCT02532764 QR-010 [eluforsen], NCT03375047 MRT5005, NCT05712538 ARCT-032 [Phase 1 healthy-volunteer DOUBLE masking with open-label CF Phase 1b per maskingDescription, retained as True under study-level designInfo rule], NCT06429176 SPL84, NCT06515002 BI 3720931; 7/17 adding NCT06237335 RCT2100 [Part 1 masked, Parts 2-3 open-label]) carried RANDOMIZED + masked study-level designInfo, yielding exact one-sided Fisher p = 20586899/867114268 = 0.02374185 >= 0.01 (all-17 p = 0.02169903 >= 0.01).
